title: Overview
description: Cluster overview: Kubernetes health, resources, and alerts. External service probes and notification delivery are not configured yet.

panels.title: Critical alerts
panels.description: Firing critical alert instances at the end of the selected period. Click to open the matching rules in Grafana Alerting. The rule list shows current state, even when the dashboard displays a historical period.

targets.expr: count(ALERTS{alertstate="firing",severity="critical",alertname!~"Watchdog|InfoInhibitor"}) or (0 * max(up{job="kube-prometheus-stack-prometheus"} == 1))

panels.title: Warnings
panels.description: Firing warning alert instances at the end of the selected period. Click to open the matching rules in Grafana Alerting. The rule list shows current state, even when the dashboard displays a historical period.

targets.expr: count(ALERTS{alertstate="firing",severity="warning",alertname!~"Watchdog|InfoInhibitor"}) or (0 * max(up{job="kube-prometheus-stack-prometheus"} == 1))

panels.title: Pending alerts
panels.description: Alert instances waiting for their confirmation period at the end of the selected period. Click to open the matching rules in Grafana Alerting. The rule list shows current state, even when the dashboard displays a historical period.

targets.expr: count(ALERTS{alertstate="pending",alertname!~"Watchdog|InfoInhibitor"}) or (0 * max(up{job="kube-prometheus-stack-prometheus"} == 1))

panels.title: Unready pods
panels.description: Distinct pods with a Pending or Firing KubePodNotReady alert at the end of the selected period. Click to open the matching rules in Grafana Alerting. The rule list shows current state, even when the dashboard displays a historical period.

targets.expr: count(max by(namespace,pod)(ALERTS{alertname="KubePodNotReady",alertstate=~"pending|firing"})) or (0 * max(up{job="kube-prometheus-stack-prometheus"} == 1))

panels.description: Non-idle logical CPU cores and total logical cores observed by node-exporter. CPU usage is averaged over the rate interval; capacity is host CPU capacity, not Kubernetes allocatable CPU. Duplicate exporter identities are averaged per node and CPU. Missing measurements are not replaced with zero. Offline nodes can remain visible until their last series becomes stale.
panels.title: CPU utilization

targets.expr: label_replace((100 * (sum(1 - avg by(instance,cpu)(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node-exporter",mode="idle"}[$__rate_interval])))) / (count(avg by(instance,cpu)(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node-exporter",mode="idle"})))), "resource", "CPU", "", "")
round((sum(1 - avg by(instance,cpu)(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node-exporter",mode="idle"}[$__rate_interval])))) / 1 * 10) / 10
round((count(avg by(instance,cpu)(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node-exporter",mode="idle"}))) / 1 * 10) / 10

panels.description: Host memory in use, calculated as total minus MemAvailable, and total physical memory. Reclaimable cache remains available. This is actual host usage, not pod requests or Kubernetes allocatable memory. Duplicate exporter identities are averaged per node. Missing measurements are not replaced with zero. Offline nodes can remain visible until their last series becomes stale.
panels.title: Memory utilization

targets.expr: label_replace((100 * ((sum(avg by(instance)(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node-exporter"})) - sum(avg by(instance)(node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="node-exporter"})))) / (sum(avg by(instance)(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node-exporter"})))), "resource", "Memory", "", "")
round(((sum(avg by(instance)(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node-exporter"})) - sum(avg by(instance)(node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="node-exporter"})))) / 1073741824 * 10) / 10
round((sum(avg by(instance)(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node-exporter"}))) / 1073741824 * 10) / 10

panels.description: Used and total capacity of ext2/3/4, XFS, Btrfs and ZFS filesystems reported by node-exporter. Each device is counted once per node, even if mounted several times. Used is size minus free, so reserved free blocks are not counted as used. Remote, temporary and overlay filesystems are excluded. Totals describe filesystems, not raw disk capacity or replicated application data. Missing measurements are not replaced with zero. Offline nodes can remain visible until their last series becomes stale.
panels.title: Local filesystems utilization

targets.expr: label_replace((100 * ((sum(max by(instance,device)(node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="node-exporter",fstype=~"ext[234]|xfs|btrfs|zfs"})) - sum(max by(instance,device)(node_filesystem_free_bytes{job="node-exporter",fstype=~"ext[234]|xfs|btrfs|zfs"})))) / (sum(max by(instance,device)(node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="node-exporter",fstype=~"ext[234]|xfs|btrfs|zfs"})))), "resource", "Local filesystems", "", "")

round(((sum(max by(instance,device)(node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="node-exporter",fstype=~"ext[234]|xfs|btrfs|zfs"})) - sum(max by(instance,device)(node_filesystem_free_bytes{job="node-exporter",fstype=~"ext[234]|xfs|btrfs|zfs"})))) / 1073741824 * 10) / 10
round((sum(max by(instance,device)(node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="node-exporter",fstype=~"ext[234]|xfs|btrfs|zfs"}))) / 1073741824 * 10) / 10

panels.title: CPU utilization
panels.description: Non-idle CPU time as a percentage of all logical CPU capacity on each node, averaged over the automatic rate interval. Includes I/O wait. Near 100% means little idle CPU time remains; it does not distinguish computation from waiting for I/O. Cluster is weighted by logical CPU count or total physical memory rather than giving equally weighted nodes.

targets.expr: avg by (nodename) ((100 * (1 - avg by(instance)(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node-exporter",mode="idle"}[$__rate_interval])))) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{job="node-exporter"}))

100 * (sum(1 - avg by(instance,cpu)(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node-exporter",mode="idle"}[$__rate_interval])))) / (count(avg by(instance,cpu)(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node-exporter",mode="idle"})))

panels.title: Memory utilization
panels.description: Percentage of RAM not available for new applications on each node: total memory minus the kernel estimate of available memory. Reclaimable cache is accounted for. A rising value means less RAM headroom. Cluster is weighted by logical CPU count or total physical memory rather than giving equally weighted nodes.

targets.expr: avg by (nodename) ((100 * (1 - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="node-exporter"} / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node-exporter"})) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{job="node-exporter"}))

100 * ((sum(avg by(instance)(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node-exporter"})) - sum(avg by(instance)(node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="node-exporter"})))) / (sum(avg by(instance)(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node-exporter"})))

panels.title: Root filesystem utilization
panels.description: Percentage of the root filesystem unavailable to ordinary processes on each node, including used space and filesystem reservations. Near 100% means little writable space remains; other mount points are not included.

targets.expr: avg by (nodename) ((100 * (1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="node-exporter",mountpoint="/",fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="node-exporter",mountpoint="/",fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay"})) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{job="node-exporter"}))

panels.description: Blog: http_2xx probe of http://blog.blog.svc.cluster.local:80/ every 30 seconds, with an 8-second timeout. Firing after 2 minutes of failed probes. Green means successful check, orange means a failed check awaiting the firing duration, red means Firing, and gray means no fresh probe or rule evaluation. Click to open this service alert. Checks run inside the cluster; TCP confirms a listening port only, and these checks do not verify public DNS, external ingress or an authenticated VPN tunnel.

targets.expr: (max(2 * ALERTS{alertname="SocratServiceBlogUnavailable",service_id="blog",alertstate="firing"} or ALERTS{alertname="SocratServiceBlogUnavailable",service_id="blog",alertstate="pending"})) or ((1 - max(probe_success{job="service-probes",service_id="blog"})) and on() ((max(up{job="service-probes",service_id="blog"}) == 1) and on() (time() - max(timestamp(up{job="service-probes",service_id="blog"})) < 90) and on() (time() - max(timestamp(probe_success{job="service-probes",service_id="blog"})) < 90) and on() (time() - max(prometheus_rule_group_last_evaluation_timestamp_seconds{rule_group=~".*;socrat.services.availability"}) < 90))) or vector(-2)

panels.title: etcd · members with a leader
panels.description: Number of scraped etcd members reporting that they have a leader, compared with the number of discovered etcd scrape targets. A gap may indicate a leader or collection problem. The target count is not an independent inventory of all expected members.

targets.expr: sum(etcd_server_has_leader{job="kube-etcd"})
count(up{job="kube-etcd"})

panels.title: Kubernetes API · available targets
panels.description: Number of Kubernetes API targets successfully scraped at each time, compared with all discovered API targets. A gap means failed scrapes. This checks the metrics endpoint, not every API operation or external access path.

targets.expr: sum(up{job="apiserver"})
count(up{job="apiserver"})

panels.title: Pods by phase
panels.description: Number of pods in each Kubernetes phase over time. Running does not necessarily mean Ready; Pending means a pod has not yet started running. Completed successful pods are excluded.

targets.expr: sum by(phase)(kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Running|Pending|Failed|Unknown"})

panels.title: Container restarts
panels.description: Estimated number of container restarts in each chart interval, shown as bars over the selected dashboard range. The interval scales with the selected range and has a 1-minute minimum to cover multiple metric samples. Shows up to ten containers with the most restarts over the entire selected range. Prometheus increase extrapolates between samples, so counts can be fractional; they are not rounded into fabricated exact events. Duplicate exporter series are removed. No restarts is shown only when source metrics are available; missing telemetry remains gaps.

targets.expr: max by(namespace,pod,container) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total[$__interval])) and on(namespace,pod,container) (topk(10, max by(namespace,pod,container) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total[$__range] @ end()))) > 0)
(0 * count(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total)) unless on() (topk(10, max by(namespace,pod,container) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total[$__range] @ end()))) > 0)

panels.title: Kubernetes API requests
panels.description: Kubernetes API requests per second, grouped by HTTP response code and averaged over the automatic rate interval. 4xx responses are client-side errors; 5xx responses are server-side errors. Missing samples are not evidence of zero traffic.

targets.expr: sum by(code)(rate(apiserver_request_total{job="apiserver"}[$__rate_interval]))
